notes: Topline: Bedrock runs payment support for several mid-size health payors. Heavy PHI + PCI. Looking for VPC deployment that isolates traffic and provides immutable audit logs.
Primary ask: agent assist (live call surface), automated ticket summarization, tool-calling to update CRM/ticketing, robust fallbacks under spikes.
Latency/throughput: 95th pctl latency target < 150ms for turn-level assist; throughput to handle 3k concurrent agents during peaks (burst to 6k).
Cost-sensitivity: willing to pay for Dedicated capacity for predictability; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce token costs without hurting summary quality.
Model preferences: prefer open models with Redwood-verified perf; want quantized variants for on-prem/VPC to lower footprint. Must support deterministic reranking for compliance trails.
Security: must support SSO via SAML/Okta, HSM-backed KMS, SOC2 attestation, HIPAA BAAs, PCI DSS attestation. Also strict retention_rules: 7 years for some logs, configurable ephemeral cache for KV.
Integration notes: telephony stack is Genesys Cloud + Salesforce Service Cloud (existing CTI). Need tool-calling adapter to push actions from assistant to ticket fields and to trigger IVR handoffs.
Quote (Head of Support): "We cannot have token leakage into logs — every generated artifact must be auditable and redact cardholder data automatically."
POC scope agreed: 3-week POC - week1: ingestion + summarization, week2: live agent assist + tool-call hooks, week3: spike test + security review.

Security review status: V1 questionnaire returned; Bedrock requested architecture diagram with egress/ingress flows and KMS key lifecycle. Legal flagged PHI retention and requested exact retention_controls mapping.
Se notes: Recommended ops config - prefix caching for common resolutions, conservative batching at 30ms window, model fallback chain (quantized open model -> larger hosted model) to preserve SLOs.
Risk: Genesys CTI adapter unknown stability — SE recommends small contract with integration partner or run CTI through a sandbox first.
Next demo: live agent assist demo with simulated payments and card-redaction rules; Diego to prepare pre-sanitized transcripts and redaction regex set.
Misc: provided pricing deck link (drive:/decks/Bedrock-Redwood-POC-pricing-v1.pptx). Bedrock asked for SLA language for Dedicated nodes and forensic log export cadence.
